diagnostic_use.rationale: Cognitive complexity records control-flow burden for this Python scope. Compare pinned per-function distributions and changed functions across snapshots as a diagnostic alongside path duplication, unused-code review, coupling, invariant regressions and later rework; do not use a score threshold as a pass/fail architecture or debt verdict.

extension_decision.rationale: The baseline has one CheckoutService coordinating quote, stock reservation, capture, shipment, atomic order-and-outbox save, and event retry through explicit ports. For a functional or non-functional change, first compare its requirements with those boundaries and invariants. Preserve the single business lifecycle where applicable; if a material requirement does not fit, change the shared domain/port contract and its dependent implementations together. SOLID principles and strategy/adapter patterns help separate varying effects and responsibilities only where that separation earns its complexity. Verify failure, compensation, idempotency, event delivery, performance and other affected qualities for the changed scope; search for redundant routes and unreachable remnants. Reinspect the current code at each later session because this baseline may become stale.

maintenance_mechanism.rationale: Repeatedly using one maintained lifecycle and reviewed extension seams can reduce duplicated maintenance sites, conflicting behaviour and architectural drift during comparable later changes. This is a conditional mechanism, not an observed causal effect. It depends on later agents retrieving and applying current guidance, reviewers finding inappropriate abstractions, suitable tests, and repeated tasks; a single implementation does not measure future debt.
